title: Running Sum of Array
statement: Given an array of integers nums, return an array result of the same length where result[i] is the sum of nums[0..i] (inclusive). This is known as the running sum of the array.
reference_solution:
def running_sum(nums):
    result = []
    total = 0
    for n in nums:
        total += n
        result.append(total)
    return result
hints: Think about how the sum of a prefix relates to the sum of the previous prefix.
You only need to remember the running total as you scan left to right, not recompute each sum from scratch.
Keep a variable total = 0; for each element, add it to total, then append total to the result list.
